help_purpose: The main tasks in Dwello, step by step.
help_buildings_1: Under «Buildings» you add a building with its address, postcode, town and year built.
help_buildings_2: Under «Apartments» or on the building’s detail page you add the apartments with apartment number, floor, area and number of rooms.
help_buildings_3: The area is the basis for distribution keys by area, so enter it accurately.
help_tenants_1: Under «Tenants» you add the tenants with their contact details and correspondence channel (letter or email).
help_tenants_2: Under «Rental contracts», «Add rental contract» guides you through the contract in five steps: tenant, apartment, contract term, rent and review. «Back» and «Next» move between the steps without losing your entries.
help_tenants_3: Only «Save rental contract» in the last step creates the rental contract. Until then, Dwello keeps your entries only in this browser; they are removed when you discard them or sign out.
help_tenants_4: When a tenancy ends, enter the contract end in the rental contract. The apartment then counts as vacant again.
help_tenants_5: On a tenant’s page you upload files under «Upload a document», such as a handover report (PDF, JPG or PNG, at most 10 MB). Delete copies of ID documents and debt collection register extracts as soon as you no longer need them.
help_invoices_1: Under «Invoices» you add each invoice from an invoice issuer with its date, amount and building.
help_invoices_2: Every invoice belongs to a category. Only invoices in allocable categories go into the utility cost statements.
help_invoices_3: You maintain categories, distribution keys and heating profiles under «Categories», «Distribution keys» and «Heating profiles», and defaults such as the billing period under «Settings».
help_invoices_4: Several invoices at once: under «Invoices», choose «Upload invoices». The AI reads the files, and you check the details before Dwello creates the invoices.
help_statements_1: Under «Utility cost statements», «Create statements» guides you in five steps: billing period, buildings, heating profile and management fee, preview and create.
help_statements_2: In the preview you check the costs: Dwello shares them out by distribution key and, when tenants change or an apartment is vacant, bills them by days rented. Only «Create drafts» creates the statements.
help_statements_3: The statements are then available as drafts. You can change the payment deadline and the notes; to correct wrong costs, create the statements again.
help_statements_4: If the tenant wants correspondence by email, Dwello sends the statement as a PDF with «Send by email» and files it under «Documents». For a letter, deliver the PDF to the tenant yourself and choose «Mark as sent» on the same day. The payment deadline runs from the day it is sent.
help_payments_1: The «Overview» shows you overdue statements and upcoming deadlines.
help_payments_2: When a payment comes in, choose «Mark as paid» in the statement.
help_payments_3: When the payment deadline has passed, «Send reminder» issues a payment reminder first, then a 2nd or 3rd reminder. It goes by email or as a letter, depending on the tenant’s correspondence channel.
help_payments_4: Letters appear under «Documents». Mark a letter as sent there on the day you post it, then print it: only then does it carry that day’s date and a new payment deadline.
glossary_period_text: The year for which you bill the utility costs, for example the calendar year or July to June. Without a service period, the invoice date decides which billing period an invoice belongs to. With a service period, its days in the billing period count.
glossary_advance_text: The tenant’s monthly advance for the utility costs. The utility cost statement sets it off against the actual costs.
glossary_net_rent_text: The monthly base rent, without utility costs; also simply called the rent.
glossary_additional_rent_text: Extra monthly rent, for example for a garage, parking space or cellar.
glossary_key_text: The rule by which a building’s costs are shared among the apartments, for example by area, by rooms or the same for each apartment.
glossary_profile_text: Spreads the heating costs over the 12 months as percentages, because more heating is used in winter than in summer. If a tenant moves in or out during the billing period, Dwello splits their heating costs by month instead of by day. You choose the heating profile when you create the statements.
glossary_fee_text: The compensation for your work on the utility cost statement: a percentage of each tenant’s own utility costs. Only allowed if agreed in the rental contract; you record that with the rental contract. Up to 3 % is usual; a higher rate must match your actual work (Art. 4 para. 3 VMWG). You choose the rate when you create the statements, unless the rental contract states its own.
glossary_days_text: The number of days a rental contract runs in the billing period. If a tenant moves in or out during the billing period, they pay only the share of their days rented and, for heating costs with a heating profile, the share of their months. The landlord bears the costs of the days an apartment stands vacant. If «Billed until» is entered for the rental contract, only the days after that date count.
glossary_allocable_text: An allocable invoice goes into the utility cost statement, for example heating, water, caretaker or refuse. Whether an invoice is allocable depends on its category; you can exclude a single invoice of an allocable category. The tenant only has to pay these costs if the rental contract names each of these cost types separately.
glossary_balance_text: The tenant’s share of the costs including the management fee, minus their advance payments, plus an amount due or minus a refund carried over from the previous statement; for a corrected statement, also minus what they already paid on the replaced statements (plus what you already refunded to them). The balance is rounded to 5 centimes, only in the tenant’s favour: an amount due is rounded down, a refund up. If the balance is positive, the tenant pays the difference (amount due); if it is negative, they get money back (refund). A balance below CHF 5.00 is neither claimed nor paid out but offset against the next statement of the same rental contract (carried over); the final statement has no minimum amount.
glossary_settled_text: Status of a sent statement that no payment follows: the balance is 0.00, or it is below CHF 5.00 and is offset against the next statement of the same rental contract (carried over). An amount carried over is therefore not paid yet: the tenant pays or receives it with the next statement. A closed statement has no payment date and gets no reminder. «Paid», by contrast, means that you have recorded a payment.
glossary_deadline_text: The date by which the tenant must have paid an amount due. For a refund, it is the date by which you transfer the amount to them («Refund by»).
glossary_reminder_text: A demand for payment that you issue for a sent statement with an amount due: first a payment reminder, then at most a 2nd and a 3rd reminder. To terminate the rental contract for late payment, you need a separate written payment deadline of at least 30 days that warns of termination; the reminders are not one.
glossary_channel_text: How a tenant receives post from you: by letter (default) or by email. Email needs an email address.
glossary_status_text: Shows whether an apartment is let: let (a rental contract is running), let from … (only a future rental contract has been signed), vacant or blocked. Let and let from … follow from the rental contracts; you set vacant and blocked when editing the apartment.
glossary_fixed_term_text: A fixed-term rental contract ends without notice on the agreed contract end. If the tenant then stays in the apartment and you let them stay without objecting, the contract becomes open-ended. An open-ended rental contract runs until notice of termination is given.
glossary_termination_date_text: A day on which an open-ended rental contract can be terminated: a date set in the rental contract or, if it sets none, a date customary in the area. After a notice of termination, it is the day on which the contract ends. Until then the contract keeps running, and its status is «terminated by notice».
glossary_notice_period_text: The time between receipt of the notice of termination and the termination date. For apartments it is at least 3 months, or longer if the rental contract says so. If the notice arrives too late, it applies to the next termination date. Other periods apply to extraordinary terminations, for example for late payment. The rental contract only ends earlier if you agree on the end with the tenant or if the tenant proposes a replacement tenant you cannot reasonably refuse.
glossary_manual_text: You changed the category the AI suggested for an invoice yourself. You can give the reason for the change when editing. The invoice list then shows «Manual», as for every invoice whose category you chose yourself.

privacy_purpose: Which data Dwello processes and where it goes.
privacy_llm_external: Invoices are categorised by {provider} ({country}) using an AI, which also reads uploaded invoice files. If you choose files under «Upload invoices», each one is transmitted immediately with its file name (for PDF files, at most the first three pages, as images), even if you cancel the upload afterwards; it contains everything on the invoice, including names and addresses. For the category, the invoice issuer (including individuals), the description and the amount of the invoice as well as the name and description of all categories are transmitted. If you have the AI check a new category, its name and description are transmitted so that the AI can suggest whether its costs are allocable. If this information contains a name, it is transmitted as well.
privacy_llm_local: Invoices are categorised with an AI, which also reads uploaded invoice files; on request it also checks whether the costs of new categories are allocable. The AI runs on the operator’s server; the invoices and categories do not leave the server for this.
privacy_llm_off: Invoices and categories are not processed by an AI.
privacy_stored_1: Dwello stores the data needed to manage the buildings and bill the utility costs: buildings and apartments, tenants with contact details and correspondence address, rental contracts, invoices, documents you upload for tenants (such as handover reports, copies of ID documents or debt collection register extracts), and the statements created, payments and reminders. The supporting documents (uploaded files of the invoices with everything on them, such as names, addresses and amounts) make it easier for tenants to inspect them and stay stored until you replace the supporting document or delete the invoice.
privacy_stored_2: The data is kept in the database of the operator of this Dwello installation.
privacy_login_1: You can sign in through {providers}. Dwello receives only the name, email address and identifier of your account with the provider, and uses them to run the session and show the name in the header. Dwello never sees your password with the provider.
privacy_third_3: When you add a building, the address search queries, through the Dwello server, the Federal Register of Buildings and Dwellings (RBD) of the Federal Statistical Office, which the Federal Office of Topography swisstopo provides on geo.admin.ch (Switzerland). swisstopo receives the search term you enter and the register number of the building you choose, as well as the IP address of the server, not that of the browser.
privacy_third_4: «Plan route» in the building list opens Google Maps (Google Ireland Limited, Ireland, and Google LLC, USA) with the building’s address. Google receives the address and the browser’s IP address only when you choose the link; the data may reach the USA. Google LLC is certified under the Swiss-U.S. Data Privacy Framework, which the Federal Council recognises as providing adequate data protection.
privacy_third_5: Apart from the services named here and under «Sign-in», no one receives data from Dwello.
privacy_cookies_1: Dwello sets only technically necessary cookies. No tracking or advertising cookies are used.
privacy_cookies_2: «dwello_session» keeps you signed in; JavaScript cannot read it. «dwello_xsrf» protects against forged requests. Both last {lifetime} from sign-in or the last extension of the session.
privacy_cookies_3: «dwello_oauth_state» protects the sign-in against forged responses, «dwello_login» remembers the chosen provider and the page that opens afterwards. Both last only during sign-in, at most 10 minutes.
privacy_cookies_4: «PARAGLIDE_LOCALE» stores the interface language for 400 days; JavaScript can read it. On the first visit Dwello sets it to your browser’s language if that is German, French, Italian or English, otherwise to German.
privacy_draft_notice: Dwello keeps unsaved entries in «Add rental contract» and «Create statements» only in this browser so that you can continue later: until you save the rental contract or create the statements, discard your entries or sign out with «Sign out». If the session merely expires, the entries stay. They may contain amounts, dates and the chosen tenant and apartment, and stay on the device you are working on. If your browser allows no site data, Dwello does not keep unsaved entries.
privacy_controller_1: As the landlord, you are the controller for the data you enter in Dwello, including that of your tenants. Dwello is run by {operator}.
privacy_controller_none: As the landlord, you are the controller for the data you enter in Dwello, including that of your tenants. The operator of this Dwello installation has not entered a name and address yet. If you run Dwello yourself, enter them in the settings file, as the installation guide describes; otherwise ask your provider for them.
privacy_controller_2: The operator is whoever sets up and runs this Dwello installation on a server: you, or a provider who runs Dwello for you. Such a provider processes the data you enter only on your behalf, as a processor. The operator is the controller for the sign-in, the server log and the cookies.
privacy_controller_3: Your tenants and other people whose data you enter, such as invoice issuers, can ask you free of charge whether and which data about them is processed, and you can ask the operator (Art. 25 FADP).
privacy_retention_1: Except in the public demo, Dwello deletes no stored data by itself. What you enter stays stored until you delete it. What cannot be deleted: statements that were sent, all reminders, and tenants and rental contracts that have statements.
privacy_retention_2: Anyone required to keep accounts, such as a property management company, must keep the accounting records and vouchers, such as invoices and statements, for 10 years from the end of the financial year (Art. 958f CO).
privacy_retention_3: Once a tenant’s last rental contract has ended, Dwello lists the documents you uploaded for them before that day, so that you can delete what you no longer need.
privacy_login_google: Google (Google Ireland Limited, Ireland, and Google LLC, USA) learns at every sign-in that you use this Dwello installation, when and from which IP address. The data may reach the USA; Google LLC is certified under the Swiss-U.S. Data Privacy Framework, which the Federal Council recognises as providing adequate data protection.
privacy_login_microsoft: Microsoft (Microsoft Corporation, USA; representative for Switzerland: Microsoft Ireland Operations Limited, Ireland) learns at every sign-in that you use this Dwello installation, when and from which IP address. The data goes to the USA; Microsoft Corporation is certified under the Swiss-U.S. Data Privacy Framework, which the Federal Council recognises as providing adequate data protection.
privacy_login_log: Every sign-in, every extension of the session (about every 50 minutes while Dwello is open) and every sign-out is recorded in the server log, with the account’s identifier and, except for the sign-out, the email address. The log serves security and troubleshooting; only the operator reads it. The operator decides for their installation how long it is kept.
privacy_mail_smtp: Utility cost statements, payment reminders and further reminders sent by email are delivered through the mail server the operator has set up. If it belongs to a provider, that provider receives the tenant’s name and email address and the message with the attached PDF: for a reminder, the address and the amount due; for a utility cost statement, the correspondence address, the apartment and the rental period, the costs and how they are shared, the balance, and the IBAN and payment reference. The operator can tell you which provider runs the mail server and in which country.
privacy_mail_resend: Utility cost statements, payment reminders and further reminders sent by email are delivered through Resend (Resend, Inc., USA). Resend receives the tenant’s name and email address and the message with the attached PDF: for a reminder, the address and the amount due; for a utility cost statement, the correspondence address, the apartment and the rental period, the costs and how they are shared, the balance, and the IBAN and payment reference; the data thus goes to the USA. The disclosure relies on the European Commission’s standard contractual clauses with the adjustments for Switzerland, which are part of Resend’s data processing addendum (Art. 16(2)(d) FADP).
privacy_mail_none: Dwello sends no email, because the operator has not set up mail delivery.
privacy_cookies_5: You can refuse or delete cookies and other site data in your browser’s settings. Without the cookies «dwello_session» and «dwello_xsrf», however, you cannot sign in, nor through a provider such as Google without «dwello_oauth_state» and «dwello_login».

buildings_fuel_intro: Only for buildings heated with oil, LPG, pellets or wood. What was consumed is billed: opening stock + purchases − closing stock. To do this, on the last day of each billing period, for example on 31.12., add the value of the fuel in the tank or store in francs. The value at 31.12.2024 is the closing stock for 2024 and the opening stock for 2025. Calculate the value like this: quantity in the tank or store multiplied by the price per unit (litre, kg or stere, a cubic metre of stacked wood) of the last delivery. If the tank or store holds more than the last delivery, calculate the rest at the price of the delivery before that. If you only read the level at the beginning of January, still add the value as at 31.12.

backend_heating_profile_shares_fixed: The monthly shares of predefined heating profiles cannot be changed.

backend_contract_not_in_period: The rental contract does not fall within the billing period. Choose another period.
backend_iban_missing: No IBAN is set. Add the IBAN in the settings.
backend_iban_company_address_missing: With an IBAN, the company address is required. Enter the name, postcode and town.

backend_reminder_too_early: The next reminder is possible from {date}: the payment deadline of the last reminder runs until {deadline}.
backend_tenant_no_email: The tenant has no email address.
backend_mail_not_configured: Email sending is not set up.
backend_statement_tenant_no_email: The tenant has no email address. Add it to the tenant and send the statement again, or deliver it by letter.
backend_statement_mail_failed: The email was not delivered. Check the tenant’s email address and send the statement again, or deliver it by letter.
backend_statement_mail_not_configured: Email sending is not set up. Deliver the statement by letter, or have email sending set up and then send it again.
backend_statement_already_sent: The statement has already been sent. Reload the page.
backend_mail_delivery_failed: The email was not delivered. Mark the reminder as sent under «Documents» on the day you post it: only then does it carry that day’s date and a new payment deadline. Then print it and send it by post. Check the tenant’s email address before the next reminder.
apartments_purpose: All apartments in your buildings with their rental status.
apartments_none_found_text: No apartment matches your search. Choose other filters or show all apartments.
apartments_none_found_search_text: No apartment matches «{search}». The search covers apartment number, building name, street and town. Check the spelling, choose other filters or show all apartments.
apartments_none_yet_text: Add the apartments of your buildings so that you can let them and create statements.
apartments_search_help: Search by apartment number, building name, street or town. Several words narrow the search, for example building name and apartment number.
apartments_number_help: Name of the apartment in the building, unique per building.
apartments_number_taken_text: The apartment number «{number}» already exists in this building.
apartments_floor_help: Position of the apartment in the building: basement, ground floor, 1st floor, 2nd floor, etc.
apartments_area_help: Net living area in square metres. Basis for distribution keys by area.
apartments_rooms_help: Number of rooms, with half rooms as is usual in Switzerland.
apartments_legend_title: What does the rental status mean?
apartments_legend_text: «Let» and «Let from …» follow from the rental contracts. You set «Vacant» and «Blocked» when you edit the apartment.
apartments_new_purpose: The apartment starts out vacant. Later you assign a tenant to it with a rental contract.
apartments_building_help: The building the apartment belongs to.
apartments_no_contract_until: Until then, no rental contract is running.
apartments_not_let: This apartment is not let at the moment.
apartments_contract_history_help: Kept as history: utility cost statements need its days rented.
apartments_status_fixed: The rental status follows from the apartment’s rental contracts and cannot be changed here.
apartments_status_select_help: Vacant: {vacant} Blocked: {reserved} An apartment becomes let through a rental contract.
apartments_save_failed: The apartment could not be saved.
contracts_flat_rate_help: Fixed monthly amount for the utility costs agreed in the rental contract. Dwello does not bill it: no amount due and no refund. Below, under «Agreed utility costs», untick the utility costs the flat rate covers.
contracts_flat_rate_warning_title: Flat-rate utility charge and ticked utility costs
contracts_flat_rate_warning_text: This tenant pays a flat-rate utility charge. Dwello still bills them for all ticked utility costs. Untick the utility costs the flat rate covers.
contracts_flat_rate_warning_text_advance: This tenant pays an advance payment and a flat-rate utility charge. Dwello bills them for all ticked utility costs in the utility cost statement, but not for the flat rate. Leave ticked only the utility costs the tenant pays an advance payment for. Otherwise they pay twice for the utility costs the flat rate covers.
tenants_purpose: The people who rent or have rented your apartments, with contact details and apartment.
tenants_none_found_text: No tenant matches the search and the filter.
tenants_none_yet_text: First add the tenants with their contact details. Then you link them to their apartment with a rental contract.
tenants_channel_help: How the tenant receives post, for example reminders. Email requires an email address; letter requires a postal address.
tenants_language_help: Dwello creates the utility cost statement and the reminders in this language.
tenants_detail_purpose: Contact details, rent, rental contracts and documents of this tenant.
tenants_export_help: Downloads everything Dwello stores about this tenant as a ZIP file: contact details, rental contracts, statements, reminders and documents. If a tenant asks for their data (Art. 28 FADP), give them this file within 30 days. First check whether documents or notes contain other people’s data. Give the file only to the tenant themselves.
tenants_delete_has_contracts: Tenants with rental contracts are kept because statements and documents refer to them.
tenants_delete_text: {name} will be deleted permanently. This cannot be undone.
tenants_delete_failed: Tenants with rental contracts cannot be deleted.
tenants_correspondence_address_help: Statements and reminders are sent to this address; after moving out, enter the new address
tenants_former_documents_text: The last rental contract of {name} ended on {date}. Before that day you uploaded: {titles}. Delete what you no longer need, such as copies of ID documents and debt collection register extracts. Keep handover reports until the rent deposit has been released.
tenants_former_documents_end_day: Dwello does not list documents here that you uploaded on the day the contract ended or later, such as the handover report at move-out.
tenants_former_documents_check_help: Once you have deleted what you no longer need, mark the documents as checked. Dwello deletes nothing; the task disappears from the overview.
tenants_no_rental: This tenant has no current or future rental contract.
tenants_edit_purpose: Contact details, correspondence channel and language of {name}.
tenants_new_purpose: Add the tenant’s name, contact details and correspondence channel.
tenants_new_purpose_contract: After that, you continue with the rental contract.

contracts_no_advance_text: Without an advance payment, the tenant usually pays a flat-rate utility charge, or the rental contract provides for no utility costs. If the signed rental contract has an advance payment, enter it. Otherwise untick all boxes under «Agreed utility costs»: Dwello then bills this tenant no utility costs. If utility costs are agreed without an advance payment, the tenant pays them in full with the utility cost statement. If the tenant pays a flat-rate utility charge, enter it under «Flat-rate utility charge per month».
contracts_start_in_past: The contract start {date} is in the past. Is the date correct?
contracts_list_purpose: Who rents which apartment, since when and at what rent.
contracts_none_found_text: No rental contract matches the search and filters.
contracts_none_yet_text: A rental contract links a tenant to an apartment, from a contract start and at a rent.
contracts_search_help: Tenant name, apartment number or building
contracts_save_failed: An error occurred while saving. Try again later.
contracts_running_text: A new advance payment applies from the day you enter for it. Dwello applies other changes immediately, including to the period not yet billed and to corrected statements. A rent increase takes effect at the earliest from the next termination date: with reasons, on the official form, received by the tenant at least 10 days before the notice period begins. Without the form or reasons it is void. Enter a rent increase only once it applies.
contracts_running_text_fixed_term: A new advance payment applies from the day you enter for it. Dwello applies other changes immediately, including to the period not yet billed and to corrected statements. For a fixed-term rental contract, a rent increase is only possible after the contract end, unless the rental contract provides for it. Give notice of an increase with reasons and on the official form, otherwise it is void. Enter a rent increase only once it applies.
contracts_parties_fixed_open: The tenant and the apartment cannot be changed. For a change of tenant or apartment, end this rental contract on its page with «End contract», then add a new one.
contracts_parties_fixed_ended: The tenant and the apartment cannot be changed. For a change of tenant, add a new rental contract starting no earlier than {date}. For a change of apartment, add a new rental contract for the other apartment. If this rental contract ends earlier than entered here, first change the contract end below under «Contract term».
contracts_parties_fixed_mistake: If you chose the wrong tenant or the wrong apartment, delete the rental contract on its page and add it again. If a draft utility cost statement already exists for it, delete the draft first.
contracts_parties_fixed_link: Go to the rental contract of {name}
contracts_new_for_tenant: Add a new rental contract for {name}
contracts_parties_fixed_by_law: If the tenant dies, the rental contract does not end by itself: it passes to the heirs. So do not change the contract end; enter one only once the heirs or you have given notice. Until then, under «Correspondence address» on the tenant, enter the address where post for the heirs should go and, for correspondence by email, also the address under «Email».
contracts_parties_fixed_transfer: If someone else takes over the rental contract, for example when a rental contract for business premises is transferred with your written consent or when a court assigns the family home to one spouse in a divorce, enter a contract end on the day before the change, without a notice period, and a new rental contract on the same terms from the day of the change.
contracts_end_death: If the tenant has died, the rental contract does not end by itself: it passes to the heirs. Enter the contract end only once the heirs or you have given notice. Until then, under «Correspondence address» on the tenant, enter the address where post for the heirs should go and, for correspondence by email, also the address under «Email».
contracts_open_contract_title: {name} has a rental contract without a contract end
contracts_open_contract_text: A rental contract without a contract end is recorded for {name} for apartment {apartment} ({building}). If {name} moves to another apartment, end that rental contract on its page with «End contract». If {name} rents both apartments, continue here.
contracts_open_contract_link: Go to the rental contract for apartment {apartment}

contracts_new_purpose: Add step by step who rents which apartment, from when and at what rent.
contracts_apartment_help: Available apartments are listed first. Apartments that are let are marked «not available» and cannot be chosen.
contracts_free_later_text: {notice}. The rental contract can start on that day at the earliest.
contracts_overlap_wizard: The period overlaps with another rental contract for this apartment. Change the contract start or choose «Fixed-term» with an earlier contract end.
contracts_confirm_past: {notice} If it is correct, click «Next» again.
contracts_draft_dropped: The chosen tenant or apartment no longer exists. Please choose again.
contracts_unlimited_help: The rental contract has no contract end. It runs until it is terminated.
contracts_limited_help: The rental contract ends on a fixed day, without notice of termination.
contracts_overlap_text: {overlap}. No two rental contracts of an apartment may overlap.
contracts_base_rent_help: Monthly base rent without utility costs.
contracts_advance_help: The tenant’s monthly advance for the utility costs agreed in the rental contract (for example heating, water). The utility cost statement deducts the agreed advance payment, not the amount paid. Settle missing payments outside Dwello.
contracts_advance_change_help: A new advance payment applies from the day under «Valid from»; the previous one stays for the time before. An increase takes effect at the earliest from the next termination date: with reasons, on the official form, received by the tenant at least 10 days before the notice period begins. Without the form or without reasons it is void. Under «Valid from», enter the day after the termination date. For a reduction, a written notice is enough.
contracts_advance_change_help_fixed_term: A new advance payment applies from the day under «Valid from»; the previous one stays for the time before. For a fixed-term rental contract, an increase is only possible after the contract end, unless the rental contract provides for it. Give notice of an increase with reasons and on the official form, otherwise it is void. For a reduction, a written notice is enough.
contracts_advance_from_help: Day from which the new advance payment applies: the first of a month. To correct an amount entered by mistake, enter its day from «Advance payment by period»; the first amount applies from the contract start.
contracts_error_advance_from_required: Enter the day from which the new advance payment applies, for example the first of next month.
contracts_advance_delete_text: The advance payment of {amount} from {from} is deleted. From then on, the advance payment of {before} applies again.
contracts_fee_help: Choose what the signed rental contract says. If it states a percentage, choose «Yes, with its own rate» and enter it. If it only says that management costs are charged, choose «Yes, at the rate of the statement run»: you then choose the rate when you create the statements. If it says nothing about it, choose «No». A new management fee during the tenancy must be notified to the tenant with the official form, with reasons, at least ten days before the notice period begins; it applies at the earliest from the next possible termination date (Art. 269d CO).
contracts_fee_run: Yes, at the rate of the statement run
contracts_error_fee_choice: Please choose whether the rental contract provides for a management fee.
contracts_error_fee_rate_zero: An own rate of 0 % means no management fee. Choose «No» instead.
contracts_error_fee_rate: Please enter a percentage from 0.01 to 10 with at most two decimal places, for example 3 or 2.5.
contracts_fee_shown_run: Agreed, rate of the statement run
contracts_agreed_costs_none_text: With no box ticked, Dwello bills this tenant no utility costs. If the signed rental contract lists utility costs, tick them. If the tenant pays all utility costs with a flat-rate utility charge, leave the boxes unticked.
contracts_agreed_costs_none_text_advance: With no box ticked, Dwello bills this tenant no utility costs. But the tenant pays an advance payment. With the utility cost statement, you refund them all their advance payments. Tick the utility costs the tenant pays an advance payment for.
contracts_agreed_costs_help: Dwello has ticked every allocable category. Untick each one the signed rental contract does not list. Dwello bills the tenant only the ticked utility costs. A general phrase such as «other utility costs» is not enough. If the rental contract names «heating costs», the chimney sweep and the other heating cost categories are included.
contracts_agreed_costs_help_edit: Dwello bills the tenant only the ticked utility costs. A general phrase such as «other utility costs» is not enough. If the rental contract names «heating costs», the chimney sweep and the other heating cost categories are included. Existing statements do not change. New utility costs can only be introduced on the official form, at the earliest for the next termination date; Dwello cannot yet bill them from a specific date.
statements_fee_not_agreed_text: No management fee is agreed for these rental contracts (as recorded with the rental contract). Their statements contain no fee (0 %). If the rental contract provides for one, record it there.
statements_agreements_text: These categories have costs in the billing period, and the rental contract does not say yet whether they are agreed. A category is agreed if it is listed in the signed rental contract. Dwello bills only agreed utility costs; you bear those not agreed. Dwello stores your answer with the rental contract. If an agreement applies only from a date in this period, for example because you introduced these costs on the official form, Dwello cannot bill them from that date yet: choose «Not agreed» and bill the rest yourself.
statements_agreements_loading: Dwello is checking whether the utility costs of this period are agreed in the rental contracts …
statements_agreements_failed_text: Dwello could not check whether all utility costs of this period are agreed in the rental contracts. You cannot continue without this check. Choose «Try again».
statements_agreements_wait: Dwello will continue as soon as the rental contracts are checked.
statements_agreements_wait_failed: Dwello could not check the rental contracts. Choose «Try again». If the check succeeds, Dwello continues.
statements_agreement_question: Is «{category}» agreed in the rental contract of {tenant} (apartment {apartment})?
statements_agreement_error: Please choose whether these utility costs are agreed in the rental contract.
statements_agreement_save_failed: Your answer was not saved. Please try again.
statements_not_agreed_text: For these rental contracts the utility costs named are not agreed (as recorded with the rental contract). Their statements do not contain them; you bear the share of these apartments. If one of them is listed in the signed rental contract, record it there.
contracts_rent_taken_over_title: Amounts from the last rental contract
contracts_rent_taken_over_text: The amounts come from the last rental contract of this apartment ({period}). If an amount was 0.00 there, its field stays empty. Check the amounts and adjust them if others apply in the new rental contract.
contracts_rent_taken_over_additional: If, for example, the new tenant does not rent the parking space, clear the additional rent.
contracts_additional_help: Additional monthly rent, for example for a garage, parking space or cellar.
contracts_review_intro: Check the details. «Save rental contract» creates the rental contract.
contracts_tenant_created_text: {name} has been saved and selected for this rental contract.
invoices_error_service_end: Please also enter the end of the service period.
invoices_error_service_start: Please also enter the start of the service period.
invoices_error_service_order: The end cannot be before the start.
invoices_error_reason: Please give a reason for the change.
invoices_purpose: The invoices of your buildings. Allocable invoices go into the utility cost statement.
invoices_empty_year_text: Add the invoices of this year so that they go into the utility cost statement.
invoices_empty_text: Add your first invoice so that it goes into the utility cost statement.
invoices_date_help: Copy the date from the invoice, not today’s date. Without a service period, it decides which billing period the invoice falls into.
invoices_service_period_help: What period does the invoice cover? Enter it for invoices covering a period, for example a quarter or a year. For the 4th quarter, that is 01.10.{year} to 31.12.{year}, even if the invoice only arrives in January. Then only the days within the billing period count.
invoices_service_period_years: Use the service period to spread costs that arise only every few years over those years. It starts on the day the work is done and ends on the day before the work is next done. An example: the water heater of the central hot water system is descaled on 01.04.{year}, and again in 5 years. Then enter 01.04.{year} to 31.03.{end}. Of CHF 500, about CHF 100 then counts towards each year, less in the first and last year. The statements of the following years automatically include their share. Anyone who moves in later pays only for their own time. If the work comes back earlier, do not change the service period of the last invoice: otherwise the parts already in a statement change. Until its end, both invoices then count. If it comes back later, none counts in the months in between.
invoices_service_period_boiler: Descaling the central hot water system is allocable (Art. 5 para. 2 let. e VMWG) if the rental contract names hot water costs as utility costs. For a water heater inside the apartment this is disputed: charge it only if the rental contract expressly names descaling the water heater as a utility cost. If in doubt, it is not allocable.
invoices_service_period_fuel: For a delivery of heating oil, LPG, pellets or wood, the consumption counts through the building’s fuel stock. Enter the day of delivery as both start and end. The delivery then counts in full in the billing period of that day, even if the invoice arrives later. Without a service period the invoice date counts; for a longer period, its last day.
invoices_outside_by_period: The service period is not within the billing period {start} – {end}. The invoice then does not go into these utility cost statements. Check the invoice date and the service period.
invoices_outside_by_date: The invoice date is not within the billing period {start} – {end}. The invoice then does not go into these utility cost statements. Check the invoice date and the service period.
invoices_billing_entity_help: Company or person issuing the invoice.
invoices_description_help: The service the invoice charges for.
invoices_period_filter: Invoices of {building} that fall into the billing period {start} – {end} (by service period, otherwise invoice date)
invoices_period_filter_all: Invoices that fall into the billing period {start} – {end} (by service period, otherwise invoice date)
invoices_in_period: of which {amount} in the billing period
invoices_key_help: How the costs are split among the building’s apartments. Dwello proposes the distribution key of the latest invoice of this category in the building, otherwise the one from the settings. Always use the same distribution key for a category.
invoices_error_key_required: Choose how the costs are split.
invoices_key_missing_note: This invoice has no distribution key yet. Dwello therefore splits it equally per apartment, as «Per Unit». Check the distribution key Dwello proposes. If you save the invoice, it applies to statements Dwello creates or recalculates afterwards; statements already created stay as they are.
invoices_allocable_help: The invoice goes into the utility cost statement.
invoices_not_allocable_help: The invoice does not go into the utility cost statement.
invoices_category_not_allocable_text: Costs in this category (e.g. repairs, building insurance) cannot be passed on to tenants.
invoices_billed_period: There are already statements with this invoice for the billing period {start} – {end}.
invoices_missed_period: There are already statements without this invoice or with an earlier version of it for the billing period {start} – {end}.
invoices_missed_text: Recalculate the drafts of this period with «Recalculate» on their page; they then bill the invoice as it is now. To correct sent statements, use «Correct statement» on the statement. The corrected statement takes into account what has already been paid. Claims arising from the utility cost statement are usually time-barred after five years (Art. 128 No. 1 CO); there is no consistent view on when the limitation period starts. If in doubt, seek advice.
invoices_ki_failed: The AI could not categorise the invoice.
invoices_save_failed: The invoice could not be saved. Please try again.
invoices_new_purpose: Add an invoice so that its costs go into the utility cost statement.
invoices_ki_active_text: As soon as the invoice issuer and description are entered, the AI suggests a category.
invoices_ki_reading: The AI is reading the invoice …
invoices_edit_purpose: Correct the invoice from {name}. Existing statements do not change.
invoices_edit_billed_text: If you change this invoice, these statements are no longer correct. Then recalculate the drafts with «Recalculate» on their page. To correct sent or paid statements, use «Correct statement» on the statement; the corrected statement takes into account what has already been paid.
invoices_override_reason_help: Why does the AI’s category not fit? The reason is saved with the invoice.
invoices_status_pending_long: Not categorised – please choose a category
invoices_delete_failed: The invoice could not be deleted. Please try again.
invoices_legal_title: Not in the utility cost statement
invoices_legal_text: This invoice is not included in the utility cost statement. Typical non-allocable costs: repairs, building insurance, property tax, mortgage interest (Art. 256 para. 1, 256b and 257a Code of Obligations, CO).
invoices_delete_text: The invoice from {name} for {amount} will be deleted. It will then no longer go into any new utility cost statement. This cannot be undone.
invoices_delete_billed_text: Delete only invoices recorded by mistake or advance invoices replaced by a final invoice. If a final invoice replaces this advance invoice, enter the final invoice first. The drafts still include this invoice: recalculate them afterwards with «Recalculate» on their page. To correct sent or paid statements, use «Correct statement» on the statement; the corrected statement takes into account what has already been paid. Keep the original invoice: the tenant may ask to inspect it.
invoices_upload_purpose: Choose the building and the files of your invoices. The AI reads the details; you check them before Dwello creates the invoices.
invoices_upload_files_label: Drag files here or choose them
invoices_upload_files_help: PDF, JPG or PNG, at most 10 MB each, up to 20 files at once. The AI reads the chosen files immediately.
invoices_upload_too_many: You can upload at most 20 files at once. The others were not added.
invoices_upload_keep_original: Keep the original invoice; tenants may inspect it.
invoices_upload_kept: Dwello stores the file of each invoice created as its supporting document. Files from which you create no invoice are not stored.
backend_extraction_unavailable: The AI is not available. Please fill in the fields.
backend_extraction_unreadable: The AI gave no readable answer. Choose «Try again» or fill in the fields.
invoices_upload_unreadable: Dwello cannot open this file. Please fill in the fields.
invoices_upload_not_read: The AI did not read this file. Fill in the fields.
invoices_upload_read_failed: The file was not read because Dwello did not respond. Choose «Try again» or fill in the fields.
invoices_upload_unsure: The AI is not sure. Please check the value.
invoices_upload_more_pages: The AI only read the first {pages} pages. Check the amount and the items on the other pages.
invoices_upload_missing: The AI did not find this value. Fill it in if it is on the invoice.
invoices_upload_add_if_shown: Add if shown on the invoice: {fields}.
invoices_upload_building_locked: The building applies to all files. Remove the files to choose another one.
invoices_upload_duplicate: This invoice has already been entered.
invoices_upload_several: This file contains several invoices. Add each one with «Add invoice» and then attach this file on its page with «Add the supporting document», or upload each invoice as a file of its own.
invoices_upload_deducted: Advance invoices of {amount} are deducted on the invoice. The amount proposed is the total before the deduction: {total}.
invoices_upload_deducted_no_total: Advance invoices of {amount} are deducted on the invoice. Enter the total before the deduction as the amount.
invoices_upload_deducted_rule: If you have already entered the advance invoices, delete them on their page with «Delete invoice», even if they are already in a statement. If their files are selected here, remove them with «Remove the file». Otherwise they count twice. Keep the service period of the invoice. If an advance invoice was already in a statement, then update the statements that contain it: drafts with «Recalculate», sent or paid statements with «Correct statement». This way each billing period bears its actual costs.
invoices_upload_reminder: This is a payment reminder. Reminder fees and default interest are not utility costs; enter the original invoice.
invoices_upload_credit_note: This is a credit note. Do not create an invoice from it. Reduce the amount of the invoice it belongs to by the credit note: in the row of that invoice if its file is selected here, otherwise on its page with «Edit invoice». Keep the credit note with the original invoice.
invoices_upload_credit_note_amount: This is a credit note of {amount}. Do not create an invoice from it. Reduce the amount of the invoice it belongs to by the credit note: in the row of that invoice if its file is selected here, otherwise on its page with «Edit invoice». Keep the credit note with the original invoice.
invoices_upload_advance_invoice: This is an advance invoice: a prepayment that the invoice issuer settles later with the final invoice. As a rule, enter only the final invoice with the total. If the final invoice arrives only after the statement of this period, tick «Create this invoice» and enter the advance invoice; delete it when you enter the final invoice.
invoices_upload_mixed: The invoice contains costs that are not allocable (e.g. repairs). Enter only the allocable amount here. Then enter the rest with «Add invoice» as a second invoice in the category Repairs and attach this file to it with «Add the supporting document».
invoices_upload_create_failed: The invoice was not created because Dwello did not respond. Please try again.
invoices_upload_none_selected: Choose at least one invoice to create.
invoices_upload_discard_text_created: Invoices already created stay saved. The other files and your entries will be lost.
invoices_upload_unticked_mixed: «Create this invoice» is not ticked because you must split the amount first. Tick it afterwards.
invoices_upload_unticked_credit: «Create this invoice» is not ticked because no invoice is created from a credit note. If the file is an invoice after all, tick it.
invoices_upload_discard_text: Uploaded files and your entries will be lost.
backend_beleg_not_found: No supporting document is stored for this invoice.
invoices_beleg_file_help: PDF, JPG or PNG, at most 10 MB.
invoices_beleg_failed: The supporting document was not saved because Dwello did not respond. Please try again.
invoices_beleg_billed: The invoice is in a statement; tenants may ask for the supporting document.
invoices_beleg_deducted: Advance invoices of {amount} are deducted on the supporting document. The amount is the total before the deduction.
invoices_beleg_deducted_rule: Check that the advance invoices are not entered as well. If one of them is still entered, delete it on its page with «Delete invoice», even if it is already in a statement, and then update the statements that contain it: drafts with «Recalculate», sent or paid statements with «Correct statement». The service period is the one on the supporting document.
invoices_beleg_mixed: The supporting document also contains costs that are not allocable (e.g. repairs). Check that the amount contains only the allocable part and that the rest is entered as a separate invoice in a non-allocable category.
invoices_delete_beleg_billed: Download the supporting document first if you need it for the tenant’s inspection.
invoices_beleg_how_replace: Choose the new file, then «Replace the supporting document».
invoices_beleg_how_add: Choose the file, then «Add the supporting document».
invoices_delete_beleg: The supporting document is deleted as well.
invoices_date_decides: Decides which billing period the invoice falls into.
invoices_service_period_days: Only the days within the billing period count.
invoices_no_key: None – the costs are split equally per apartment, as «Per Unit»
categories_save_failed: The category could not be saved.
categories_delete_failed: The category could not be deleted.
documents_purpose: Reminders and other letters to tenants, and documents you uploaded for tenants. Mark a letter as sent on the day you post it: Dwello then puts that day’s date and a new payment deadline on it. Then print the letter and post it the same day.
documents_update_failed: The document could not be updated.
documents_empty_text: Reminders and documents you upload for a tenant appear here.
documents_print_now: The letter now carries today’s date and a new payment deadline. Print it now and post it today.
statements_paid_help_refund: The day you transferred the amount.
statements_paid_date_invalid: Please enter the payment date as DD.MM.YYYY.
statements_paid_date_future: The payment date is in the future. Enter the day the money arrived.
statements_correct_open: Statement {number} is replaced by a corrected statement. The previous one is kept unchanged, no reminders are sent for it any more and it can no longer be marked as paid. Enter what the tenant has already paid under «Already paid».
statements_correct_open_settled: Statement {number} is replaced by a corrected statement. The previous one is kept unchanged. If a sent next statement already contains its balance as carried over, the corrected statement counts it as «Already offset»: the tenant does not pay or receive it twice. If a draft contains it as carried over, Dwello removes it from the draft at once; the corrected statement then settles the whole balance. If the corrected statement’s balance is again below CHF 5.00, recalculate the draft after sending the corrected statement.
statements_correct_open_refund: Statement {number} is replaced by a corrected statement. The previous one is kept unchanged and can no longer be marked as paid. Enter what you have already paid under «Already refunded».
statements_correct_paid: Statement {number} is replaced by a corrected statement. The previous one is kept unchanged. The corrected statement takes into account the {amount} paid on {date}.
statements_correct_refunded: Statement {number} is replaced by a corrected statement. The previous one is kept unchanged. The corrected statement takes into account the {amount} you refunded on {date}.
statements_correct_paid_chain: Statement {number} is replaced by a corrected statement. The previous one is kept unchanged. The corrected statement takes into account the {amount} paid in total on it and on the statements it replaced.
statements_correct_refunded_chain: Statement {number} is replaced by a corrected statement. The previous one is kept unchanged. The corrected statement takes into account the {amount} you refunded in total on it and on the statements it replaced.
statements_correct_settled: Statement {number} is replaced by a corrected statement. The previous one is kept unchanged.
statements_correct_next: Then you can correct the contract dates and invoices if needed and create the corrected statement. Send it to the tenant.
statements_correct_limit: Claims arising from the utility cost statement are usually time-barred after five years (Art. 128 No. 1 CO); there is no consistent view on when the limitation period starts. If in doubt, seek advice.
statements_correct_failed: The statement could not be replaced. Try again.
statements_create_correction_failed: The corrected statement could not be created. Try again.
statements_replaced_todo: If contract dates or invoices are wrong, correct them now. Then create the corrected statement.
statements_summary_replaced: This statement is replaced and no longer applies. What the tenant still pays or gets back is in the corrected statement.
statements_advance_differs_title: Different advance payment than in the replaced statement
statements_advance_differs: The advance payments of this statement ({now}) differ from those of the replaced statement {number} ({before}). If an earlier amount in the rental contract is wrong, delete this draft, enter the amount with its «Valid from» date and create the corrected statement again.
statements_reset_payment_text: Statement {number} then counts as unpaid again and has the status «{status}». The payment date {date} is deleted. The history records the reset.
statements_reset_payment_done: The payment of statement {number} has been reset.
statements_reset_payment_failed: The payment could not be reset. Please try again.
statements_error_period_start: Please choose the start of the billing period.
statements_error_period_end: Please choose the end of the billing period.
statements_error_period_order: The end must be after the start of the billing period.
statements_error_fee: Please enter a percentage from 0 to 10 with at most two decimal places, for example 3 or 2.5.
statements_error_buildings: Please choose at least one building.
statements_finding_gap_one: The invoice for {parts} is missing. Previous year: {invoices}.
statements_finding_gap_many: The invoices for {parts} are missing. Previous year: {invoices}.
statements_finding_stock_missing_one: The fuel stock on {dates} is missing.
statements_finding_stock_missing_many: The fuel stocks on {dates} are missing.
statements_finding_stock_tail: Without opening and closing stock, Dwello bills the purchases, not the consumption. But you may only bill the consumption: add the stock on the building’s page. Only confirm if the tank was equally full at the start and at the end.
statements_finding_stock_negative: The closing stock is {amount} higher than the opening stock and purchases together; the consumption would be negative. Check the fuel stocks and whether a delivery is missing or its invoice is dated after the end of the period.
statements_finding_consumption_more: Consumption {amount}, {percent} % more than in the previous year ({previous}). Check the fuel stocks.
statements_finding_consumption_less: Consumption {amount}, {percent} % less than in the previous year ({previous}). Check the fuel stocks.
statements_finding_missing: No invoice added in this category. Previous year: costs of {amount}.
statements_finding_new: New: {amount}, no costs in the previous year. Dwello bills these costs only for rental contracts in which they are agreed (as recorded with the rental contract). Check whether they are listed in the signed rental contracts. You can introduce new utility costs only for the future, at the earliest for the next termination date: with reasons, on the official form, received by the tenant at least 10 days before the notice period begins. Without the form or reasons the change is void.{fixedTerm} If the costs were included in the net rent so far, lower it accordingly.
statements_finding_more: {amount}, {percent} % more than in the previous year ({previous}). Check the amount and the period the invoice covers.
statements_finding_less: {amount}, {percent} % less than in the previous year ({previous}). Check the amount and the period the invoice covers.
statements_finding_partial_one: 1 invoice counts only in part: its service period reaches beyond the billing period.
statements_finding_partial_many: {count} invoices count only in part: their service periods reach beyond the billing period.
statements_late_title: Invoices shortly after the billing period
statements_late_text: These invoices have no service period. They therefore count in the billing period of their invoice date, not in this one. If one of them belongs to this billing period, enter its service period.
statements_uncategorized_text: These allocable invoices have no category. Dwello bills only utility costs agreed in the rental contract and checks this through the category. Assign a category to each invoice or set it to «Not allocable». Then you can go on.
statements_uncategorized_error: Some allocable invoices have no category. Assign a category to each invoice or set it to «Not allocable».
statements_whole_text: The billing period is shorter than a year. These invoices have no service period and therefore count with their whole amount. If one covers more than this billing period, for example a whole year, enter its service period. Then only the part of the amount that falls into this billing period counts.
statements_heating_whole_title: Heating costs: invoices without a service period
statements_heating_whole_text: These invoices in the category ‘{category}’ have no service period, while others in the same category do. Enter one for each so that each tenant bears the costs of their own months. If an invoice applies to the whole billing period, enter that period.
statements_heating_whole_text_many: These invoices in the categories {categories} have no service period, while others in the same category do. Enter one for each so that each tenant bears the costs of their own months. If an invoice applies to the whole billing period, enter that period.
statements_akonto_above: Costs are {amount} ({percent} %) above the advance payments.
statements_akonto_raise: Check whether to raise the advance payment. An increase takes effect at the earliest from the next termination date: with reasons, on the official form, received by the tenant at least 10 days before the notice period begins. Without the form or reasons it is void.
statements_akonto_raise_fixed_term: Check whether to raise the advance payment. For a fixed-term rental contract, an increase is only possible after the contract end, unless the rental contract provides for it. Notify the tenant of an increase with reasons and on the official form, otherwise it is void.
statements_finding_new_fixed_term: For a fixed-term rental contract, an increase is only possible after the contract end, unless the rental contract provides for it.
statements_akonto_below: Costs are {amount} ({percent} %) below the advance payments. Are invoices missing?
statements_mark_paid_failed: The statement could not be marked as paid. Please try again.
statements_reminder_failed: The reminder could not be created.
statements_purpose: Check, send and track your tenants’ statements.
statements_scope_contract: You are seeing the statements of the rental contract of {tenant}, apartment {apartment} ({building}), contract start {start}.
statements_scope_period: You are seeing the statements of the billing period {start} – {end}.
statements_empty_text: Create your first utility cost statement.
statements_no_reminder_after: After that you can no longer send a reminder.
statements_send_failed: The statement could not be sent.
statements_delete_failed: The statement could not be deleted.
statements_later_one: 1 invoice of the billing period has been added, changed or deleted
statements_later_many: {count} invoices of the billing period have been added, changed or deleted
statements_later_fuel_stock: the fuel stock of the billing period has been changed
statements_later_and_fuel_stock: {later}, and the fuel stock has been changed
statements_later_draft: Since this draft was created, {later}. Choose «Recalculate» to bill the invoices and the fuel stock as they are now.
statements_recalculate_text: Dwello recalculates draft {number} using the invoices and the fuel stock as they are now. The number, heating profile, management fee, statement date, payment deadline and notes stay unchanged. The amounts, statement lines and balance change. Any PDF already created is discarded.
statements_recalculated: The draft is recalculated. It bills the invoices and the fuel stock as they are now.
statements_recalculate_failed: The draft was not recalculated. Please try again.
statements_send_outdated_title: This draft is not up to date
statements_send_outdated: Since this draft was created, {later}. Recalculate it before you deliver it.
statements_later_sent: Since this statement was created, {later}. To correct sent statements, use «Correct statement» on the statement. The corrected statement takes into account what has already been paid. Claims arising from the utility cost statement are usually time-barred after five years (Art. 128 No. 1 CO); there is no consistent view on when the limitation period starts. If in doubt, seek advice.
statements_later_sent_none: Since this statement was created, {later}. For {tenant}, this changes neither the balance nor any statement line. You do not need to correct the statement.
statements_later_sent_declined: Since this statement was created, {later}. On {date}, you decided not to correct the statement.
statements_later_lowers: Recalculating gives {tenant} a lower amount due or a larger refund. Correct the statement, otherwise you are asking for more than the actual costs.
statements_later_title_fuel_stock: Fuel stock changed since the statement
statements_later_title_both: Invoices and fuel stock changed since the statement
statements_decline_correction_text: Statement {number} stays as it is. The task «Correct statement» disappears from the overview, and the statement’s history records that you did not correct it. You can still correct the statement later. If another invoice or the fuel stock changes the balance or a statement line again, the task appears again.
statements_pdf_failed_reason: The PDF could not be created: {reason}
statements_pdf_failed: The PDF could not be created. Please try again.
statements_delete_text: Statement {number} for {tenant} will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
statements_rental_days_label: Days rented in the billing period
statements_reminder_by_email: Dwello creates «{next}» in {language} as a PDF and sends it by email to {email}.
statements_reminder_by_letter: Dwello creates «{next}» in {language} as a PDF and puts it under «Documents». Mark the letter as sent there on the day you post it. Then print it and send it by post.
statements_no_more_reminders_text: 3 reminders have already been sent. Dwello cannot create another one. Agree on the next steps directly with the tenant.
statements_reminder_257d: A reminder from Dwello is a request for payment. It does not set a payment deadline with a warning of termination under Art. 257d CO. Further steps, e.g. debt collection proceedings or termination for payment arrears under Art. 257d CO, take place outside Dwello. For this termination, you first set the tenant a payment deadline of at least 30 days in a separate letter, with a warning that you will terminate the rental contract. Seek advice.
statements_reminder_undelivered: The document «{title}» is ready to send under «Documents». {reason}
statements_reminder_emailed: The document «{title}» was sent by email.
statements_reminder_letter: The document «{title}» is ready to print as a letter under «Documents».
statements_no_lines: No statement lines: no invoices were added for this billing period.
statements_part_share_zero: Your share: ({sum}) × your apartment’s share under the distribution key = {share}
statements_part_stock: Change in fuel stock {start} – {end}: {amount}; your days rented: {days} of {total}
statements_part_beyond: Service period {wholeStart} – {wholeEnd} (invoice {wholeAmount}), of which {start} – {end}: {amount}; your days rented: {days} of {total}
statements_part_no_period: No service period: {amount}; your days rented: {days} of the {total} days in the billing period
statements_part_line: Service period {start} – {end}: {amount}; your days rented: {days} of {total}
statements_part_line_profile: Service period {start} – {end}: {amount}; share under the heating profile: {percent} %
statements_part_no_period_profile: No service period: {amount}; share under the heating profile: {percent} %
statements_part_beyond_profile: Service period {wholeStart} – {wholeEnd} (invoice {wholeAmount}), of which {start} – {end}: {amount}; share under the heating profile: {percent} %
statements_part_stock_profile: Change in fuel stock {start} – {end}: {amount}; share under the heating profile: {percent} %
statements_send_text_1: Dwello does not send the statement itself. Mark the statement as sent on the day you deliver it to the tenant. Dwello then files it under «Documents». Print it from there.
statements_send_text_2: Dwello dates the statement on the day you mark it as sent. So deliver the PDF on the same day.
statements_send_email_text: Dwello sends the statement as a PDF by email to the tenant and files it under «Documents». Dwello dates the statement on the day it is sent. The payment deadline is as many days later as set in the settings; a later payment deadline you entered on the statement stays.
statements_old_address: {name} has moved out. The address is still that of the apartment. Enter the new address.
statements_summary_due: The tenant pays the amount due of {amount}.
statements_summary_waived_due: The amount is less than CHF 5.00. You waive it.
statements_pdf_view_failed: The PDF could not be created. Close this tab and try again later.
statements_save_failed: The statement could not be saved.
statements_refund_by_help: By this date you refund the amount to the tenant.
statements_deadline_help: By this date the tenant pays the amount due.
statements_notes_help: For example an agreement with the tenant. The remark appears in the PDF the tenant receives.
statements_recalculate_hint: Costs and the management fee are calculated when the statements are created and cannot be changed here. «Recalculate» on the draft’s page takes over changed invoices and a changed fuel stock. For another heating profile or rate, delete the draft and create the building’s statements again.
statements_generate_purpose: Create the utility cost statements of a billing period for whole buildings. This creates drafts that you then check and send.
statements_confirm_needed: Confirm that the statements should be created anyway.
statements_nothing: Choose another billing period or other buildings. To recalculate a draft, choose «Recalculate» on its page.
statements_resume: With «Next», Dwello calculates the preview with the new invoice.
statements_draft_dropped_building_one: A building from your entries no longer exists. Dwello removed it from the selection. Check the buildings in step {number} «{step}».
statements_draft_dropped_building_many: {count} buildings from your entries no longer exist. Dwello removed them from the selection. Check the buildings in step {number} «{step}».
statements_draft_dropped_heating_profile: The heating profile from your entries no longer exists. Choose another one in step {number} «{step}».
statements_building_billed_one: Of {total} rental contracts in this billing period, {billed} already has a statement for this period.
statements_building_billed_many: Of {total} rental contracts in this billing period, {billed} already have a statement for this period.
statements_building_billed_all_one: The only rental contract in this billing period already has a statement for this period. No new statement is created for this building. You do not need to choose it. If you choose it, nothing is created for it.
statements_building_billed_all_many: All rental contracts in this billing period already have a statement for this period. No new statement is created for this building. You do not need to choose it. If you choose it, nothing is created for it.
statements_building_period_overlaps_one: {building} already has a statement for {periods}. The chosen billing period overlaps it.
statements_building_period_overlaps_many: {building} already has statements for {periods}. The chosen billing period overlaps them.
statements_building_period_choose_text: Bill the rental contracts without a statement in the billing period {periods}.
statements_building_period_short_text: Bill the remaining days in a short billing period {periods}.
statements_short_period_help: Check the rental contracts (often under utility costs) for a billing period. If they state one, it applies until the tenants agree to a change in writing. Without their agreement, give notice of the change with reasons on the official form, at least ten days before the notice period begins. It applies at the earliest from the next possible termination date (Art. 269d CO). Until then, bill according to the billing period in the rental contract.
statements_building_period_short_many: Bill the remaining days in short billing periods: {periods}.
statements_building_period_vacant: No rental contract has days rented on the remaining days; there is nothing to bill.
statements_building_recalculate: To recalculate a draft, choose «Recalculate» on its page. Sent statements cannot be recalculated.
statements_all_buildings_left_out_one: «All buildings» leaves out 1 building whose rental contracts all already have a statement in this billing period.
statements_all_buildings_left_out_many: «All buildings» leaves out {count} buildings whose rental contracts all already have a statement in this billing period.
statements_period_proposed: Dwello suggests the last completed billing period, as set in the settings.
statements_period_running_text: The billing period has not ended yet. The statements count the advance payments for all months, including those not yet paid, and invoices up to the end of the period are still missing. Create the statements only after the period has ended.
statements_preview_running_text: The billing period has not ended yet. The advance payment counts for all months, including those not yet paid, and invoices up to the end of the period are still missing. Create the statements only after the period has ended.
statements_building_no_invoices: No invoices added in the billing period
statements_heating_help: Spreads the heating costs over the months when tenants change; choose the profile your rental contracts provide for. Dwello spreads by the heating profile and cannot take meter readings into account. If the heating or hot water meters in the apartment were read when the tenants changed, those values apply: then create the statement of this apartment outside Dwello and delete the drafts of all rental contracts of this apartment, even if you create the statements again later. If your building has heat or hot water meters or heat cost allocators (small devices on the radiators) in the apartments, you usually have to bill by consumption. Dwello cannot do this: then create the statements outside Dwello. Only heating profiles adding up to 100 % can be chosen.
statements_fee_help: Percentage of each tenant’s own utility costs, for tenants whose rental contract provides for a management fee. Up to {max} % is usual. If the rental contract states its own rate, that rate applies. Without an agreed management fee, the statement contains none.
statements_fee_above_text: The management fee is higher than the usual guideline of {max} %. Check whether the extra work justifies it.
statements_tank_title: Do you heat with oil, LPG, pellets or wood?
statements_tank_text: Then add the fuel stock at the start and end of the period, otherwise Dwello bills the purchases instead of the consumption. If the building uses district heating, mains gas or a heat pump, or the tank is decommissioned, record this on the building’s page. Dwello then stops asking.
statements_no_tank_for: Mark as «No tank or tank decommissioned»: {name}
statements_vacancy_note: The total does not include the share for vacant apartments or for days billed outside Dwello.
statements_preview_billed_until: Billed until {date} (on the rental contract): days rented and advance payments from {from}
statements_preview_skipped: {name}: billed until {date} (on the rental contract). Dwello will not create a statement for this rental contract for this billing period.
statements_preview_all_skipped: All rental contracts in {building} have already been billed outside Dwello for this billing period («Billed until» on the rental contract).
statements_fee_of_own: {percent} % of each tenant’s own utility costs, for tenants with an agreed management fee. A rate stated in the rental contract takes precedence.
statements_missing_text: No invoices have been added for {names} in the billing period. Without invoices their costs are missing from the statements, and the tenants get most of their advance payment back. Add the invoices first – or confirm below that there are none.
statements_existing_text: For {name}, this billing period already has {statements}.
statements_existing_note: Existing statements stay as they are, drafts included. Rental contracts with a statement in this period do not get a new one. To recalculate a draft, choose «Recalculate» on its page.

config_help_heating_profile: Spreads the heating costs over the 12 months as percentages. If a tenant moves in or out during the billing period, their heating costs are calculated by month instead of by day – more heating is used in winter than in summer.
config_help_distribution_key: Decides how a building’s costs are shared among the apartments, for example by area, by rooms or in equal parts. Every invoice has a distribution key; you choose it when you add the invoice.
config_help_management_fee: Compensation for your work on the utility costs: a percentage of the own utility costs of each tenant whose rental contract agrees a management fee. Up to 3 % is usual; a higher rate must match your actual work (Art. 4 para. 3 VMWG). Dwello accepts at most 10 %.
config_help_accounting_period: The period for which you bill the utility costs, for example calendar year (01.01.–31.12.), July–June or November–October.
